text: Granddaughter, 2 months old. Temperature 38. Took it under her arm, then again to be sure, same number. I think she's alright in herself, she's wide awake, eyes following me round the room, making her little noises at the telly, and when she does nod off she wakes up easy enough. She's got a few bites on her arm, mosquitoes maybe, she keeps rubbing at them. Not sure if 38 counts as a fever at her age or not. Does she need to be seen tonight, yes or no
